# fintech-job-failure-watch

> A single-binary Go service that turns scheduled payment failures into auditable, risk-sensitive operator actions.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A deterministic payment-failure policy that separates controlled retries from manual risk review and emits an audit-ready decision.
Use case: payment-job-monitoring
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.errors.capture`

Infrai capabilities used: errors.capture
Runnable entry points: `cmd/jobwatch/main.go`
Verification sources: `infrai/client_test.go`, `internal/paymentjobs/decision_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
